scripts.typecheck: turbo run typecheck && tsc -p tooling/tsconfig.json && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.agents:doctor: agentyx doctor && agentyx install --dry-run | grep -q "0 to create, 0 to update, 0 to remove"
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:tooling && pnpm build:showcase && pnpm smoke:setup && pnpm smoke:npm
scripts.smoke:setup: cargo build -q -p entwine-cli && node tooling/smoke-setup.ts --binary target/debug/entwine
scripts.smoke:npm: pnpm --filter @entwine/cli build && cargo build -q -p entwine-cli && node tooling/smoke-npm.ts --binary target/debug/entwine
